title: Content Identity Wire V1 (session create and trial metadata)
description: The envelopes the Python and JS SDKs actually send under traigent.content_identity.v1 (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md section 18): SessionContentIdentityWireV1 is the session-create body's top-level content_identity; TrialContentIdentityWireV1 is a trial result's metadata.content_identity. Everything in them is a CLIENT DECLARATION (provenance 'declared'): the Backend stores, recomputes and labels it (section 11) and it can never satisfy a certificate claim on its own. An envelope is sent only when the SDK holds a Backend purpose-key grant (PurposeKeyGrantV1); without one the SDK sends no content_identity at all. Each slot is either a schema-valid object or null; a null slot names its reason in unavailable, and a withheld agent/evaluator slot claims no id source. The inner objects are exactly their own contracts (AgentVersionV1, EvaluatorVersionBindingV1, DatasetIdentityV1, EvaluatedSetV1, ObservedProviderVersionV1), narrowed to what the SDKs emit. Additive; no existing contract changes. Every string pattern in this file ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) instead of $ (see content_identity_v1_schema.json).

ContentIdentityUnavailableReasonV1.description: Closed vocabulary of why a content-identity slot is withheld, shared by both SDKs. Content-free by construction: a reason never carries data. purpose_keys_unavailable / purpose_key_provider_failed: no usable grant (reserved: under the no-grant-no-envelope rule neither SDK currently puts them in an envelope). row_not_canonicalizable: some dataset row cannot be canonicalized, so the dataset (and every trial's evaluated set) has no identity. row_outside_dataset: the trial evaluated a row that is not a row of the identified dataset (or carries another key's id). evaluation_results_unavailable: the per-example results (or, JS session only, the dataset rows) were not available to the SDK. members_exceed_inline_cap: more than 2,000 distinct members; the whole slot is withheld until the member-list store (members_ref) exists. conflicting_example_ids_truncated: the dataset's conflicting_example_ids list was cut to its first 1,000 (sorted) ids. agent_id_unavailable: no usable agent id (declared or fallback). agent_manifest_unavailable: the build manifest could not be built. config_not_canonicalizable: the configuration (base or trial) cannot be fp2-digested. evaluator_id_unavailable: the declared evaluator id is not a ForeignKeyId (Python SDK; the JS SDK reports evaluator_manifest_unavailable). evaluator_manifest_unavailable: some EvaluatorVersionManifestV1 field is not KNOWN (built-in or declared), so no evaluator version is claimed.

ContentIdentityProvenanceV1.description: Who asserts the envelope's facts. 'declared': the client computed them; nothing is server-witnessed until the Backend recomputes it (section 11).

ContentIdentityIdSourceV1.description: How the agent / evaluator id was obtained: 'declared' by the caller, or a 'fallback' (agent: the function name; evaluator: 'sdk_local_evaluator'). A fallback id is not a stable identity and must not be merged with declared history.

WireAgentVersionV1.description: An AgentVersionV1 as the SDKs send it: the build manifest is always inlined, so the Backend can recompute build_digest. Not necessarily certifiable (coverage may be 'partial').

WireEvaluatorBindingV1.description: An EvaluatorVersionBindingV1 as the SDKs send it: resolution is always 'declared_at_session_start' (only the Backend can witness scoring) and the manifest is always inlined. The SDKs emit it only when EVERY manifest field is known (built-in scoring, or declared by the caller); otherwise the slot is null with evaluator_manifest_unavailable.

WireDatasetIdentityV1.description: A DatasetIdentityV1 as the SDKs send it: record_state 'draft' (client-declared until the Backend stores and recomputes it) with the members inlined. members_ref is not sent: above the 2,000-member inline cap the whole slot is null with members_exceed_inline_cap.

members.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free object/array): members
members.description: The inline cap: at most 2,000 distinct (example_id, example_version) members. Above it the SDK sends the whole slot as null with members_exceed_inline_cap.

WireEvaluatedSetV1.description: An EvaluatedSetV1 as the SDKs send it: members inlined (members_ref is not sent; above the cap the slot is null with members_exceed_inline_cap). trial_id, when present, equals the envelope's trial_id.

members.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free object/array): members
members.description: The inline cap: at most 2,000 distinct (example_id, example_version) members. Above it the SDK sends the whole slot as null with members_exceed_inline_cap.

WireObservedProviderVersionV1.description: An ObservedProviderVersionV1 as the SDKs send it: every field present, unknowns as explicit null (system_fingerprint included), call_count always stated.

SessionContentIdentityWireV1.description: Session-create content_identity. Null-slot rules (enforced below): agent is null exactly when unavailable.agent is present, and then agent_id_source is null; evaluator is null exactly when unavailable.evaluator is present, and then evaluator_id_source is null; dataset is null exactly when unavailable.dataset is present; unavailable.conflicting_example_ids only accompanies a non-null dataset. Consumers MUST also check that dataset.key_id equals key_id (not expressible here).

key_status.description: Always 'available': an envelope exists only when the SDK holds a purpose-key grant.

key_id.description: kid of the granted purpose keys that minted every identifier in this envelope.

agent.description: The base agent version (default configuration applied).

unavailable.description: Slot name -> reason, for every withheld slot. Empty when nothing is withheld.

TrialContentIdentityWireV1.description: A trial result's metadata.content_identity. Null-slot rules (enforced below): candidate is null exactly when unavailable.candidate is present; evaluated is null exactly when unavailable.evaluated is present. observed_provider_versions is always present; empty means nothing was observed (an honest unknown, not 'no providers'). Consumers MUST also check that evaluated.key_id equals the session envelope's key_id and evaluated.trial_id (when present) equals trial_id.

candidate.description: The agent version this trial's configuration defines.

unavailable.description: Slot name -> reason, for every withheld slot. Empty when nothing is withheld.
